name: Mento British Pound
oneLiner: GBPm is Mento's British pound stablecoin on Celo, minted from CDPs collateralized by USDm with oracle-priced redemption and reserve transparency.
collateral: Mento's CDP architecture uses USDm as the collateral asset for GBPm; the public reserve API is a portfolio view rather than an exhaustive borrower-position inventory
pegMechanism: CDP-backed Mento FX stablecoin: borrowers mint GBPm against USDm collateral, while repayment/redemption mechanics and oracle pricing route value back through the Mento system

oracleRisk.summary: Mento V3 routes rates through SortedOracles and OracleAdapter, while BreakerBox rejects stale, out-of-bounds, or off-hours feeds before swaps/CDP routes use them.

mintAuthority.summary: GBPm is a legacy StableTokenV3 (cGBP) whose mint() is authorized via the Celo Registry Broker (0x777A...). The token owner and proxy admin both resolve to the 4/6 Mento Safe (0x58099...). Signercount corrected from 7 to 6 (one signer rotated out, confirmed via Safe API).

controls.label: Mento Broker — authorized minter for GBPm via Celo Registry
controls.evidence: At Celo block 69287341, deprecated_broker_storage_slot__() on GBPm (StableTokenV3, 0xccf663b1ff11028f0b19058d0f7b674004a40746) returned 0x777A8255cA72412f0d706dc03C9D1987306B4CaD. Celo Registry getAddressFor(keccak256('Broker')) also returns 0x777A..., confirming it is the live authorized minter. isMinter(Broker) = false (StableTokenV3 uses registry-based auth, not isMinter mapping).

controls.label: Mento Safe — GBPm token owner and proxy admin
controls.evidence: At Celo block 69287341, owner() on GBPm returned 0x58099B74F4ACd642Da77b4B7966b4138ec5Ba458; EIP-1967 proxy admin slot returned the same Safe address. Safe API (celo chain) confirmed threshold 4, 6 owners (drift from prior 7-owner data — one signer rotated out), no modules, zero guard, fallbackHandler 0xfd0732Dc9E303f09fCEf3a7388Ad10A83459Ec99.

review.evidence: At Celo block 69287341: owner() = Safe 0x58099B74F4ACd642Da77b4B7966b4138ec5Ba458 (confirmed); EIP-1967 proxy admin slot = same Safe; Safe API: threshold 4, 6 owners (corrected from stale 7), no modules, zero guard. Mint authorization: deprecated_broker_storage_slot__() = 0x777A... (Mento Broker); Celo Registry keccak('Broker') lookup = 0x777A... confirming live Broker is the authorized minter. All mint-capable surfaces resolved.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: GBPm is part of Mento's local stablecoin system and is documented as available directly on supported chains. No holder-facing bridge or lockbox route was resolved for GBPm, so Pharos treats route risk as native issuance on the relevant chain deployments.
